reason: My Notes app and Google Docs already do everything I need, and they're free and already on every device I own. I might poke at the free tier out of curiosity, but I'm not paying $6 a month to move my lists into something new.
objection: Who can see my notes, money and client stuff once an assistant is reading everything I snap or type? It says nothing about privacy or whether I can export it all and leave if it shuts down.
would_change_my_mind: A clear promise that my data is private and not used for training, plus one-tap export to plain files or Google Docs, so trying it costs me nothing if I leave.
